examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The console Application page in a `ConsolePanel` `#scene` slot: each tab plays its page, then opens the create drawer (list tabs) or raises the save bar (form tabs).
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import ConsoleApplicationScene from '@aziontech/webkit/assets/console-application-scene'
  import ConsolePanel from '@aziontech/webkit/console-panel'

  const tabs = [
    { value: 'build', title: 'Build' },
    { value: 'device-groups', title: 'Devices' },
    { value: 'rules-engine', title: 'Rules' },
    { value: 'main-settings', title: 'Settings' }
  ]
</script>

<template>
  <ConsolePanel
    eyebrow="Azion Console"
    title="The Application, tab by tab"
    description="Every tab owns its own list, its own create drawer and its own save."
    :tabs="tabs"
  >
    <template #scene="{ tab }">
      <ConsoleApplicationScene :tab="tab" />
    </template>
  </ConsolePanel>
</template>

examples.name: Band
examples.summary: One scene per tab in the `MediaTabs` `#media` slot at a narrower design `width`; `active` replays the second move when its tab comes back.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import ConsoleApplicationScene from '@aziontech/webkit/assets/console-application-scene'
  import MediaTabs from '@aziontech/webkit/media-tabs'

  const tabs = [
    {
      value: 'build',
      title: 'Build',
      description: 'Connect a repository, pick the framework preset, and deploy a branch.'
    },
    {
      value: 'device-groups',
      title: 'Device Groups',
      description: 'Group requests by user-agent, so a rule can treat a phone differently.'
    },
    {
      value: 'rules-engine',
      title: 'Rules Engine',
      description: 'Order what happens on request and on response, rule by rule.'
    }
  ]
</script>

<template>
  <MediaTabs
    :items="tabs"
    position="right"
    size="large"
    :autoplay-interval="4600"
  >
    <template #media="{ index, active }">
      <ConsoleApplicationScene
        :tab="tabs[index].value"
        :active="active"
        :width="760"
        class="size-full"
      />
    </template>
  </MediaTabs>
</template>
